branchProtection._comment: Read by scripts/install/setup-branch-protection.sh (#8103). These are the check-run names of every ci.yml job that ALWAYS runs and can actually fail — no job behind `needs: changes` (a skipped path-filtered job that never reports would block merges), and not the advisory drift check. `CI Result` (#10444) is the always-run aggregate that fails when Detect Changes is cancelled; it is listed here but must NOT be applied to the live ruleset until it has reported on main (a required context that never reports blocks every merge) — rerun setup-branch-protection.sh as an operator step after that. Names are the job's `name:` with matrix values substituted, verified against live check-runs on main.
